description: Retrieve real-time trending Google searches for any country, including search volume tiers (e.g. "50000+"), breakout status, and clustered news context. Cost: 6 Credits / call ($0.50–$0.75/1K; 0 Credits on 4xx/5xx error).
name: google_trends_realtime

data.description: Real-time Google Trends breakout list for the requested country.

trends.description: Surging search topics with approximate volume and related news.

news_articles.description: Clustered news stories explaining the trend.

meta.description: Response telemetry metadata including request_id, credit cost, cache hit flag, and latency.

cached.description: True when served from warm Redis/PostgreSQL cache.

count.description: Number of primary result items returned.

credits_charged.description: Credits deducted for this call (0 on 4xx/5xx error).

request_id.description: Unique UUID identifying this API request.

title: Google Realtime Trending Searches & Breakout Topics
